evidence.quote: Duration of the course / programme: 7 semesters

notes: No tuition fee is stated anywhere on the supplied page for self-financed non-EU/EEA applicants (the page only mentions the Stipendium Hungaricum and Diaspora scholarships, which is not a tuition of 0), so tuition and intakes/applicationChannel are not included: the page gives no application platform, start date or deadline.

note.fr: Un entretien d'admission (examen oral) en ligne est requis.
note.en: An online entrance examination (oral interview) is required.

note.fr: Le processus d'admission comprend deux étapes : vérification des documents puis un entretien Skype.
note.en: The admission process has two steps: document check and a Skype interview.

evidence.quote: The entrance eximination proces consists of two steps: first our admission officers will check the submitted documents to examine the eligibility of the applicants. The second step is a Skype interview, that gives a chance for the Admission Committee to check the aims and motivation for choosing this field of study.
